name: act1_goblin_camp_no_fight
title: Act 1 → into the Shattered Sanctum without a fight
about: Sandbox (family 2): reach the Shattered Sanctum inside the goblin camp with no combat on the way (talk, stealth, disguise, the tadpole; the method is reported). The positive conjunct is the Sanctum (D8): no combat alone would pass a do-nothing agent. claude-run-2 S015 got in by accepting Olak's war paint.

note.where: The road to the goblin camp, before its gate; out of combat, no dialogue open.
note.objective: Get inside the Shattered Sanctum without a fight.

character.name: Tav
character.brief: A level-headed half-elf paladin (Oath of Devotion), once a Baldur's Gate city watch sergeant: protects the weak, keeps promises, distrusts mind magic and anyone who offers easy power.
